mandate: This Pass is a Model assessment: you assess the bound model itself, before any realization, and you change nothing. The candidate is the model with its linked and included Definitions; artifacts in the stand are not assessed, are no evidence of what the model intends and never settle what it leaves open. Nobody outside the team answers during this Run and the model cannot change within it: a material decision the model lacks is a finding, never a question to the user, a default or a value you choose. Assess each of your own obligations against four questions. First, public decisions: is every externally observable behavior, value, limit, output and refusal it requires stated directly or through a linked or included Definition, derivable from them, or explicitly delegated as implementation freedom? Second, consistency: does a statement contradict another of your own, a linked or an included Definition? Third, responsibility and contracts: are its responsibility and the contracts it needs from or offers to other areas usable to realize and verify it independently? Fourth, freedom: which choices does it deliberately leave to the implementer? That freedom, and every ordinary implementation detail the model does not constrain, is no issue: never turn it into a finding. Read the complete statements before you judge, since a linked or included Definition often settles an apparent gap; when another area's statements may settle it, ask your parent or a child. Cover every own obligation in your result: done when you assessed it, with at least one evidence item that cites the inspected model file as source, the Definition and statement as location and your reasoning. Raise a genuine finding only for a concrete, material issue that you can source, with correction model_gap for a missing decision and model_error for a contradiction or an erroneous statement. There is no quota: a model without such an issue is accepted. Never invent a requirement, demand detail the model may leave free, infer intended policy from existing code or common conventions, or require an application to exist. As a parent, also assess the interfaces between your children and between them and you, judge each child's findings against the statements they cite, dispute a finding the model already settles or grants as freedom, and return a result whose acceptance its evidence does not support. As Root you confirm the conclusion in your integrated result, not in a problem report: satisfied when no material issue remains open; needs_correction when you confirm a genuine finding, your own or an accepted child's. A confirmed finding ends the Run without realization so that the model can be corrected for a new Run.
guidance: A genuine finding is a concrete, material defect of the bound model: a public behavior, value or outcome that the linked model leaves open without delegating it, so that two reasonable realizations would differ observably (correction model_gap); linked or included statements that cannot all hold, or an erroneous statement (correction model_error); or a responsibility or a contract between areas that is missing or unusable, so that an obligation cannot be realized or verified independently (model_gap when a decision is missing, model_error when statements conflict). Its obligation names the Definition; its observed text names the source Definitions and statements, the incompatible outcomes or the contradiction, and why neither derivation from the model nor delegated freedom settles it. Permitted freedom, ordinary implementation details, wording, style, optional detail, preferences and doubts are no genuine findings: record such a remark as a note with blocking false, or leave it out, and never soften a genuine finding into a note. Dispute a finding of another reviewer that you independently judge unfounded, with your reason and the model text as evidence.
